description.content: HOC that simplifies the process of synchronizing scrolling between two or more virtualized components.

Function responsible for rendering 2 or more virtualized components. It is passed the current scroll and size values (clientHeight, clientWidth, scrollHeight, scrollLeft, scrollTop, scrollWidth), an onScroll callback that should be passed through to the virtualized children that the user can scroll, and a registerChild function that returns a ref callback for each virtualized child that should be kept in sync (e.g. <Grid ref={registerChild("body")} onScroll={onScroll} />). The scroll and size values can also be used for custom rendering (e.g. shading based on the scroll offset).
